scope: Capture coverage and comparability for the 21 published splats; archive paths are relative to the preserved source archive.
coreFinding: No cohort has validated metric-scale road coverage. Compare resource cost only within exact selected source-image cohorts, and label it per selected capture sample; usable metres per cost are unknown.

evidence: Offpath preflight/rig-physical-plausibility-audit.json explicitly says units are arbitrary reconstruction units; no calibrated metres or measured vehicle speed; status physical_rig_plausibility_reopened_long_training_blocked.
Corner A/B camera-alignment preflight has no georeferenced/metric survey claim; its similarity alignment residuals are in SfM units.
Original turn reconstruction reports COLMAP-unit camera extent; low reprojection error is not a scale validation.
Half-block capture manifest says exact registration and loop closure are pending; shared camera route uses COLMAP/viewer units and records no verified metric camera height.
metricScale.safeDenominator: For current descriptive comparisons, use the same selected input extent within a cohort. Counts identify that extent; timestamps, lens pairs and projected images are not physical or useful coverage, and must not be used to rank different streets.

pipelineAndLabor.manualEffortRecommendation: Keep hands-on hours unknown. Manifests document workflow stages (paired extraction, projection, reconstruction, guarded train/eval split, masks, training, compression/export, QA); counting artifacts/steps is not a substitute for observed human time and must not be scored as labor.
